subject: HTML export: generalize the Tools filter to a message-type filter
description:
PARKED, opportunistic.

The HTML export page has a "Tools" dropdown that filters by tool name. Generalize it to filter
by BLOCK TYPE — agent spawns, thinking, attachments — keeping tool-name granularity as a
sub-case rather than replacing it.

Code: claude-replay-html/src/html/export.js (the filter menu) and the block classification it
reads, `block_kind` in claude-replay-engine/src/model.rs.

Listed in DESIGN.md's backlog. No decision outstanding; it just has never been worth a slot.

Note the harness rule: any scroll or viewport change in export.js must extend
claude-replay-browser-tests/tests/browser_follow.rs. A filter that hides rows changes document
height, so check whether the follow/anchor contract is affected.
